scientific_intent.scientific_task: Estimate payload bytes from common32-bit word patterns without producing a compressed bitstream.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Classify each low32-bit word by ordered zero/signed-byte/signed-halfword/zero-lowhalf/two-bytehalves/repeated-byte/default predicates; sum selected1,2or4 bytes.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 262144 independent UInt64 containers with16 balanced literal low32-bit patterns;1024 groups256 lanes reduce to one UInt32 counter.
invariants: Exact byte total524288 for hand-enumerated per-pattern costs.
Branch and predicate-mask variants preserve the same ordered category priority.
No counter overflow occurs at selected size; UInt64 high32bits are zero in the fixture.
accuracy_requirements: Full native observable: one UInt32 bytecount, losslessly emitted Int32, exact vs independently tabulated16-pattern costs and both references on all5trials.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Bit patterns and signed interpretation determine categories; INT_MIN unsigned-magnitude handling included. Not a floating-point codec.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: 2MiB device input,1MiB semantic32-bit uncompressed words,0.5MiB estimated payload;16-category-balanced fixture,10 reset/kernel repetitions. Original wgs256 selects4Mwords rather than this262144-word fixture.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Generic frequent-pattern compression size estimator; no particular scientific dataset or application provenance established by source.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No actual serialization, metadata cost, decompressor, throughput on scientific distributions, or lossless round-trip certification.
